acceptance: No real account username remains in tests/unit/platforms/credentials/test_snowflake_defaults.py; the test passes.
context: Found 2026-10-13 while checking public exposure of Snowflake trial account identifiers.
description:
## Problem
`tests/unit/platforms/credentials/test_snowflake_defaults.py` (lines 35, 47 and 62 on develop) uses the maintainer's real Snowflake login name as fixture data. The repository is public. A username is not a credential, but it identifies a real account and can help target it.

## Change
Replace it with a neutral placeholder such as `TEST_USER` and keep the test's assertions equivalent.
